reading.zh: 编译顺序：类型与注解 → 参数与函数骨架 → 临时寄存器 → 表达式 → 运算与内建 → 指针访存 → 语句降级 → 签名与资源 → 编译入口。
reading.en: Compilation order: types and annotations, parameters and prologue, temporary registers, expressions, operators and builtins, pointer access, statement lowering, signature and resources, then the entry point.
